jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


THE TEAM CONTEXT

Nu Global is a key driver of Nubank's international expansion, announced on September 10. It is building a simple, trusted financial experience for customers across markets. Nu Global offers a multi-currency digital account for people with global lives, that allows fee-free, fast money movement across more than 35 countries. Check the Nu Global experience https://nu.com/global/en and announcement https://nu.com/en/newsroom/company/nu-united-states-nu-global.

We are looking for an IC8/M4 Product Manager to provide senior product leadership across Nu Global Core and Growth, connecting customer experience, business strategy, risk, and execution across geographies.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Nu Global is a key driver of Nubank's international expansion. It is building a simple, trusted financial experience for people with global lives through a multi-currency digital account that enables fast, fee-free money movement across more than 35 countries.

As Senior Staff Product Manager, you will be the senior product reference for Nu Global and a strategic partner to the Business Area Lead. 

You will own product direction across Core and Growth, set portfolio priorities, and lead through influence across Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Marketing, Risk, Legal, and external partners.

You will combine hands-on ownership of critical Core journeys with strategic oversight of the Growth portfolio, while raising the product craft and operating bar across the business unit.




YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Product strategy and portfolio leadership

 - Define the Nu Global product vision, strategy, outcomes, and 12–24 month roadmap across Core and Growth.

 - Identify the most important problems to solve, make explicit product and investment trade-offs, and align senior stakeholders across markets and functions.

 - Act as a senior escalation point for ambiguous, cross-functional, and cross-market decisions.

Core & Growth product experience

 - Own major parts of the Core value proposition and the critical customer journeys required to deliver a simple, high-quality global experience.

 - Drive roadmap, dependencies, launch readiness, risk mitigation, and post-launch learning across multiple teams within the organization - namely Global Product and Platforms.

 - Raise the bar for product quality and craft in partnership with Design/Nu Design System team and Engineering, applying scalable platform standards where relevant.

 - Provide strategic oversight for Growth across acquisition, waitlist, onboarding, activation, and referral—setting direction, priorities, and measurement. Active champion of Growth Hacking and experimentation, driving the team towards rapid learning cycles

 - Ensure the product scales across countries while balancing local requirements, customer experience, regulatory obligations, and long-term platform reuse.

Product craft and multiplier impact

 - Serve as a technical and product reference for the BU on product architecture, data flows, platform constraints, operational consequences, and scalability.

 - Mentor PMs and senior partners; raise the bar for Product Sense, Product Execution, prioritization, metrics, communication, and decision quality.

 - Establish reusable product standards, rituals, and decision mechanisms that improve how multiple teams operate.

 - Contribute to hiring, onboarding, calibration, and PM chapter or guild initiatives.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Nu Global has one coherent Core and Growth strategy, with clear priorities, ownership, sequencing, and outcome metrics.

 - Teams execute with greater autonomy because dependencies, decision rights, risks, and operating mechanisms are explicit.

 - The acquisition-to-activation funnel is measurable and continuously improving across markets.

 - Critical KYC, defense, and operational responsibilities are integrated into the customer experience without avoidable launch risk.

 - Product craft and strategic thinking improve across the BU, not only within the role’s immediate scope.
   
   


LOCATION FOR THIS OPPORTUNITY

São Paulo




OUR BENEFITS

 - Chance of earning equity at Nubank

 - Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)

 - Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)

 - NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

 - Life Insurance

 - Medical Plan

 - Dental Plan

 - NuLanguage – Language Course Program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - Extended Parental Leave

 - Daycare Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Gym Partnerships

 - 30 days of paid vacation

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable




OFFICIAL WORK MODEL

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/



Explore how we build technology at Nubank:

 - building.nubank.com.br https://building.nubank.com.br

 - YouTube https://youtube.com/@building-nubank

 - Listen to our stories on Spotify https://open.spotify.com/show/4hAJnAkYKXl42hLXa4LmVQ

 
 

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

jobs.title: Senior Staff TPM - Core Infrastructure & Platform Evolution
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at the Senior Staff level to serve as a horizontal technology leader across our Core Infrastructure and Platform teams. At Nubank, a TPM is an Outcome Owner—an engineer at heart with the programmatic capability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from inception to production. You are fully accountable for the efficiency, scaling, and modernization of our foundational platforms.

Your mission is to lead horizontal infrastructure transformations at a massive scale. You will optimize database and network utilization, steer regionalization strategies, and guide our architectural evolution—whether that means refactoring monoliths into microservices or right-sizing macro-services. Crucially, you will be at the forefront of integrating AI into our core foundational platforms and ML infrastructure to maximize engineering leverage.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own Infrastructure Evolution: Lead programmatic execution for large-scale architectural shifts, including microservices refactoring, service optimization, and complex regionalization strategies.

 - Maximize Efficiency & Scale: Drive initiatives to drastically increase hardware, database, and network utilization across our global infrastructure footprint.

 - Steer AI/ML Platform Transformations: Own the program roadmap for embedding cutting-edge AI capabilities and advanced ML infrastructure directly into our foundational core platforms.

 - Collaborate Horizontally: Roll up your sleeves to map out and manage deep technical dependencies across disparate infrastructure, data engineering, and platform squads.

 - Define North-Star Architecture: Partner with senior engineering stakeholders to determine what our destination, long-term technical architecture looks like, converting that vision into actionable engineering phases.

Core Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

 - The "Engineer‑First" Background: A proven foundational background as an Infrastructure, Site Reliability (SRE), or Core Backend Engineer earlier in your career before moving into technical program leadership. Please note: This is not a project coordinator role. We require deep technical expertise in these areas to effectively guide the engineering organization.

 - Hands-on Technical Leadership: A strong track record of driving initiatives not just through tracking, but through active technical contribution. You possess the hands-on technical leadership and ability to unblock teams using your own technical expertise when complex engineering bottlenecks arise.

 - Ownership & Entrepreneurial Mindset: A distinct ownership mentality with an entrepreneurial, "raise the bar" attitude. You don't just manage a roadmap; you treat the infrastructure as your own product, constantly pushing for higher standards of engineering excellence, efficiency, and scale.

 - High-Scale Infrastructure Depth: Extensive experience managing massive cloud-native systems, focusing heavily on core networking, distributed databases, and high-utilization environments.

 - AI Transformation Experience: A highly valued track record of leading or heavily contributing to AI/ML transformation initiatives at scale.

 - Architectural Mastery: Proven ability to navigate complex architectural patterns (monoliths, microservices, nano-services) and successfully execute horizontal multi-year infrastructure roadmaps.

 - Execution Mindset: Strong business acumen, executive communication skills, and a natural ability to step in and aggressively unblock engineering teams in an agile, fast-moving environment.




OUR BENEFITS

 - Top Tier Medical Insurance

 - Top Tier Dental and Vision Insurance

 - 401(k) matching

 - 20 days time off, 14 company holidays, and great culture that emphasizes work life balance.

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

 - Twice a week in the office + quarterly trips to Sao Paulo (Brazil) to build relationships with coworkers.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here https://script.google.com/a/macros/nubank.com.br/s/AKfycbwvrewE58oGSbRWIVv8CyCWN68GLxpPVsfYYXv-ZHg94QFsTJmi82rF1x0yt-OTs2W0DQ/exec

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE 

We're hiring an experienced, curious Product Marketing Manager to shape how our products are positioned, launched and grown in Mexico. It's an individual contributor role that leads mostly through influence. You'll be the closest partner to the Product and Growth teams on narrative, go-to-market, segmentation and product consideration, and you'll run launches end-to-end. You'll use research, customer behavior and data to find barriers and opportunities, size their impact, and decide on audience, message, channels and investment. You'll join a small, ambitious team that works fast, iterates and uses AI heavily, and from day one you'll help shape roadmaps and full-funnel strategy. This is a high‑ownership role, changing the financial inclusion in Mexico.



YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 

 - Setting the strategy: turning company and product strategy into clear positioning, segmentation, and go-to-market choices: where we play, who we serve, and how we win in Mexico.

 - Owning the story end to end: building one consistent narrative across the product ecosystem, including campaigns, owned channels, paid media, influencers, customer journeys, and support.

 - Shaping the roadmap early: partnering with Product and Research from the start so customer needs, barriers, and proof points drive what we build and how we talk about it.

 - Leading launches: running GTM for new products and updates, and aligning cross-functional teams on investment, audiences, channels, messaging, and success metrics.

 - Knowing the customer deeply: understanding the lifecycle, segments, and jobs-to-be-done, and working with Product and Growth to make every journey coherent, on-brand, and relevant to Mexican customers.

 - Reading the market: maintaining a sharp view of Mexico's competitive landscape and turning research, data, and competitive signals into clear calls on what we say, build, and test next.

 - Building the operating system: establishing rituals for narrative development, launch readiness, prioritization, measurement, and quarterly planning.

 - Cutting through ambiguity: bringing clarity and sound judgment to cross-functional problems, balancing strategic quality with speed.

 - Raising the bar: codifying best practices and creating reusable playbooks that level up Product Marketing.

 - Working AI-first: using AI for writing, research, analysis, and workflow automation, and continually finding ways to move faster and go deeper.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

 - 5–8+ years in product marketing or very similar roles at consumer tech or fintech companies, including time as a PMM on high‑impact launches.

 - Proven track record owning end‑to‑end product or major feature launches with clear, quantified business impact.

 - Strong customer-insight judgment: you can combine qualitative research, quantitative data, market signals, and frontline feedback into a clear point of view.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools as a natural part of your day‑to‑day work.

 - Strategic GTM leadership: designing customer-led plans tailored to product tiering, with the operational excellence required to execute them effectively.

Nice to Have

 - Experience across multiple areas (e.g., growth, brand, lifecycle, paid) and working with senior cross‑functional stakeholders.

 - Experience using experimentation, lifecycle communications, or customer journey orchestration to drive activation and usage.

 - Experience working with product-led growth, digital platforms, or mobile applications.

 


WORK SETUP 

Location

Mexico City, Mexico 

Work model

Hybrid
Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 


OUR BENEFITS 

 - Chance of earning equity at Nu

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Health and life insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

 - 17 days of paid vacation with 25% vacation bonus

 - Gym partnership

 - Food card

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable
